labels: Similarity (white chip above Dot Product box)
Dot Product (two lines: 'Dot' / 'Product', inside gray box)
K.q (red text at top-right of Dot Product box)

W_q^(0) (purple box label; superscript tiny, best read as (0))
Probabilities (white chip above Soft max box)
Soft max (vertical text inside lavender column)
Σ (large red symbol inside light-blue box)

equations: K.q (dot product of each key Kᵢ with query q₂, producing similarity scores)
Soft max (softmax normalization of the 4 similarity scores into probabilities)
Σ (weighted sum of probability × Vᵢ terms)
1×d · W(d×d) = 1×d (legend: a 1×d vector times a d×d weight matrix W yields a 1×d vector)

layout.arrangement: Title centered at top with slide-number circle '8' at top-right; bold subtitle line beneath the title; one large diagram panel (peach fill, red border) fills the rest of the slide. Inside the panel the dataflow runs left to right: left column = input embeddings (green dashed container) feeding green W_k boxes producing key strips K₄–K₁ into a gray 'Dot Product' box; bottom-center = query path (sentence row X₁–X₄ with X₂ highlighted magenta → purple W_q box → q₂) with a large translucent blue annotation circle; center = tall lavender 'Soft max' column with 'Probabilities' chip above; right-of-center = four red ⊗ multiply nodes combining softmax outputs with value strips V₄–V₁ produced by blue W_v boxes from a right-side green dashed embedding container; top-center = light-blue Σ box with 'Weighted SUM' chip emitting (thick green arrow) a green-bordered output strip labeled Y; bottom-right = green dashed legend box explaining W dimensions.

layout.hierarchy: The diagram panel dominates (~85% of slide area). Next in weight: the bold black/blue title, then the red-accented subtitle. Within the diagram, the largest shapes are the gray Dot Product box, the lavender Soft max column, and the blue Σ box; the eye is pulled by red arrows/labels, the magenta-highlighted X₂, and the big translucent blue circle. Smallest elements: vector cell strips, weight-box text, chips, and legend text.

visual_elements.description: End-to-end self-attention dataflow for query word X₂. LEFT: green dashed rounded container holds 4 embedding strips labeled X₄, X₃, X₂, X₁ (top→bottom); each strip is a row of ~5 small squares (yellow, then a square bearing red 'Xᵢ', then pink/lavender squares). Each row arrows right into a green box 'W_k^(0)', which arrows into a small key strip labeled K₄/K₃/K₂/K₁ (yellow+pink cells, dark-red label), which arrows into a gray 'Dot Product' box containing 4 small blue dots along its right edge aligned with the incoming arrows; white rounded chip 'Similarity' sits above the box and red text 'K.q' at its top-right. BOTTOM-CENTER: horizontal green dashed container holds sentence embeddings X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄ (left→right) with X₂ highlighted (pink fill, magenta dashed border); a thick red block arrow points up-right at X₂; above it a purple box 'W_q^(0)' (magenta dashed outline) produces 'q₂' (label plus small yellow/pink strip); dotted red lines run from q₂ up into the blue dots of the Dot Product box; a large semi-transparent blue circle highlights the q₂/W_q region and reaches up into the Dot Product box. CENTER: tall lavender rectangle with vertical text 'Soft max'; white chip 'Probabilities' above; thin red arrows carry the 4 scores from the Dot Product box into Soft max and out to 4 red ⊗ (multiply) nodes stacked vertically. RIGHT: mirror of the left — green dashed container with strips X₄…X₁ feeding blue boxes 'W_v^(0)' producing value strips labeled V₄/V₃/V₂/V₁, each arming leftward into a ⊗ node. TOP: all four ⊗ outputs arrow up into a light-blue box containing a large red 'Σ'; white chip 'Weighted SUM' above-right; a thick green block arrow points from Σ up to the output: a green-bordered strip of cells labeled 'Y' (green bold). Faint green dashed curves connect the bottom sentence row around the far left and far right edges up to the left and right embedding containers (same inputs feed both K and V paths). BOTTOM-RIGHT: green dashed legend box: small strip labeled '1×d', yellow square 'W' with 'd×d' beneath it, red '=', small strip labeled '1×d'; red bold caption 'd: Embedding Length'.
